The size of the culvert shall be determined by the county highway supervisor. The culvert’s material and installation must comply with these requirements or the culvert will be removed by the county. All associated costs for removing the culvert and restoring the ditch shall be charged to the property owner. County Highway Department Installations: The county highway department will install a drive culvert when all of the following conditions are met: 1.)
